title: Artificial Intelligence in Banking: Revolutionizing Finance and Data Security
description: AI is used in banking for fraud detection, credit decisions, risk monitoring, compliance, customer service, and the data problems finance cannot shrug off.
short_description: A grounded guide to fraud detection, credit scoring, compliance, customer data, and the risks that keep banking AI on a short lead.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in Banking for bankers, risk teams, fintech readers, and anyone tracking financial infrastructure.
